scope: Governed file-export errors and export audit logging

behavior.export_failure: Export API/CLI failures expose only the bounded exception class, omit raw details, attempt failure audit logging, and remove a partial temporary file.
behavior.audit_failure: Export-log database and cursor/connection cleanup warnings contain only bounded exception classes; the best-effort audit behavior remains non-fatal.

coverage: export writer failure omits exception details from the raised error
partial temporary export is removed and failed status is audit-attempted
audit database failure warning contains no raw connection details
audit cursor and connection close failures are class-only
existing export filter and ClickHouse ordering behavior remain covered

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; fake export and logging boundaries

limitations: No collection data, live export, PostgreSQL service, or ClickHouse service was used.
This does not establish export content parity or tenant authorization for downstream consumers.
